description: This file is a Java source class for managing user-related operations within a Spring MVC web application, including CRUD operations, password management, and password reset workflows for user accounts in an admin context.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing user accounts, security, and password workflows in the admin section.

methods.name: displayUsers
methods.description: Displays the user list page, setting up menu and view template.

methods.name: pageUsers
methods.description: Handles AJAX request for paginated list of users based on current admin's privileges.

methods.name: displayChangePassword
methods.description: Displays change password form for the logged-in user.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Processes password change requests, validating and updating the user's password.

methods.name: displayUserCreate
methods.description: Displays form to create a new user.

methods.name: displayUserEdit
methods.description: Retrieves user by ID and displays edit form.

methods.name: displayUser
methods.description: Populates model with user data, groups, languages, and questions for user creation/edit form.

methods.name: checkUserCode
methods.description: AJAX endpoint to verify if username is already taken.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Validates and saves user info; sends email on creation.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Deletes a user record based on provided user ID.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets active menu items for the view.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Initiates password reset process, retrieving security questions for username.

methods.name: resetPasswordSecurityQtn
methods.description: Completes password reset after verifying security question answers, and emails new password.
